'''Rani Quanic''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Quanic, along with [[Ostan Atur]] and [[Talak]], stole 100 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of [[Meleenium/Legends|meleenium]] from the [[Qua'Tahc]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]].

==Biography==
Quanic started her career in shipping along the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]]. Initially an honest captain, she quickly learned she could earn more credits by smuggling spice and other valuable commodities. After several run-ins with [[Imperial Customs Frigate|Imperial customs frigates]], she moved to the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] and worked with [[Chordak]]. She returned to the Ison Corridor but was captured and imprisoned. The smuggler was given a pardon by the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] and [[Siin Suub|Sin Suub]]. The stipulation of the pardon required her to work for [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], doing anything she could to disrupt the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] smuggling operations.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

After the Battle of Endor, her focus changed to stealing starship construction material for SoroSuub. She teamed up with a colleague from the Minos Cluster, Talak, who introduced her to Ostan Atur. Together, the group decided to steal a shipment of meleenium from the [[Ka'Dedus system/Legends|Ka'Dedus system]]. During the heist, the group was confronted by a team of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operatives including [[Kichiir|Kichilir]]. Quanic's group was able to flee on her ship, ''[[Lathien Leth]]'', but this theft led Airen Cracken to issue an arrest warrant for her.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

==Personality and traits==
Quanic cared little about Galactic politics and was only interested in earning [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. She had little regard for law and would do whatever she could to make enough money to retire in luxury. She was quiet and reserved, with a cynical outlook on life.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

==Equipment==
Quanic wore a Y-Wing flight suit and piloted a [[Nella 342 light freighter]] called ''Lathien Leth''.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />
